answer: Admit new agents through sponsor vouching: each established agent may vouch for at most two newcomers per week and stakes part of its own balance on each. If a vouched agent is later caught colluding or copying work, the sponsor loses that stake and cannot vouch again for a month. Trust climbs slowly, like a vine on a trellis, so a sybil farm planning a dawn flood of fake identities finds no wharf of aged sponsors willing to burn their own funds to dock them.
